facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 46°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) 15 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 24 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 23 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 2 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) and the lowest at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: 23.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 40.0 in (2023), 30.2 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: 36.2 in on April 19; earlier seasons: 61.3 in (2023), 38.0 in (2024), 35.1 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 9 and July 19, carried from the melt-out dates at Decline Creek (4,480 ft) and Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Decline Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 18, 1,573 ft below the pass; points to May 12 to July 18

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 2,113 ft below the pass; points to May 7 to July 20
